definitions.explanation: Pain in a tooth or teeth. The Sino-Japanese ({音読|おんよ}み) reading; the same kanji are also read {歯痛|はいた} in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {歯痛|しつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
{歯痛|しつう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep at night because of a toothache.

examples.japanese: {歯痛|しつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The toothache persisted, so I went to the dentist instead of putting up with it.

notes:
{歯痛|しつう} is the Sino-Japanese (⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧) reading for tooth pain. In casual speech the same kanji are often read {歯痛|はいた}, or people simply say ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ (my tooth hurts).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯痛|しつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a toothache
- {歯痛|しつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to relieve tooth pain
- {歯痛|しつう}{止|ど}め: painkiller for toothache

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: my tooth hurts — the everyday spoken phrasing
